notes.title: "The Dragon and the Djinn" Livestream
notes.notes:
The demo of [i]The Dragon and the Djinn[/i] will be Livestreamed by Noordin Ali Kadir (@WerewolfFeels) as part of Steam's NextFest.

Everyone knows these stories. A young man with a magic lamp comes out of nowhere to claim a throne. A dragon appears to terrorize a city and a prophesied chosen one arrives to slay it, magical sword in tow. What they don’t know is everything that comes after—namely, you.

You arrive in the capital city of Ghariba chasing after your sister, the prophesied chosen one, who stole the magical sword you made in search of her destiny. But it’s your destiny that awaits you instead.

[i]The Dragon and the Djinn[/i] will be released in the summer of 2022.
